parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, telegram_chat_id FROM tenants WHERE status = 'active' AND telegram_chat_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_request_log WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND received_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND received_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS anfragen_gesamt,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_request_log WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND intent = 'create_event' AND received_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND received_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS termine_erstellt,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_request_log WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND intent = 'save_memory' AND received_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND received_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS notizen_aufgaben,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_request_log WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND intent IN ('add_hubspot_note','update_deal_stage','create_hubspot_contact','create_hubspot_deal') AND received_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND received_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS hubspot_aktionen,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_leads WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND created_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS neue_leads,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jonas_memory WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND status = 'done' AND updated_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND updated_at < date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS erledigte_aufgaben
